name: King County 211
description: Start here for housing, shelter, food, transportation, benefits, and local service referrals in King County.

name: Washington Poison Center
description: Free expert help with medication mistakes, drug interactions, overdoses, and toxic exposures.

name: Northwest Immigrant Rights Project
description: Free or low-cost immigration legal help in Washington for many low-income immigrants, asylum-seekers, and refugees.

name: DSHS Community Services
description: Help with Basic Food, cash assistance, documents, interviews, and benefit questions.

name: Washington Healthplanfinder
description: Human help with Apple Health and health coverage questions. Interpreter support is available in many languages.

name: Washington LawHelp
description: Plain-language Washington legal information, including eviction, notices, and court steps. Good if you need to read before you call someone.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: National crisis support by call, text, or chat. Good first stop if you need urgent emotional support anywhere in the U.S.
